settings.label: Access token
settings.meaning: Reads and writes the account's contacts, companies, deals and notes. Sent as a Bearer token.
settings.whereToFind: A developer-platform app with static auth and private distribution (legacy private apps can no longer be made), installed in the account: Development › Projects › the project › the app › Distribution › Install now, then Show to reveal the token. Give the app read and write scopes for contacts, companies and deals. For test, install the same app in a developer test account (Development › Test accounts) and Show the token next to it under Test installs: a test account's token looks like a live one.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from HubSpot: HubSpot signs each delivery with the app's client secret.
settings.whereToFind: Development › Projects › the project › the app › Auth › Client credentials › Client secret. Only needed to receive webhooks.

operations.name: contacts.create
operations.purpose: Creates a contact with these properties, optionally associated with other records. Fails with a conflict when the email is taken.

operations.name: contacts.get
operations.purpose: Reads one contact by its id, or by its email with idProperty=email.

operations.name: contacts.update
operations.purpose: Changes some of a contact's properties.

operations.name: contacts.search
operations.purpose: Finds contacts by their properties (an email, for one), a page at a time. Search is rate limited to five requests a second per account, and a record can take a few moments to appear in it.

operations.name: contacts.batchUpsert
operations.purpose: Creates or updates contacts matched by email (idProperty=email), up to 100 at a time; each result says whether it was new.

operations.name: companies.create
operations.purpose: Creates a company with these properties, optionally associated with other records.

operations.name: companies.get
operations.purpose: Reads one company by its id.

operations.name: companies.update
operations.purpose: Changes some of a company's properties.

operations.name: companies.search
operations.purpose: Finds companies by their properties (a domain, for one), a page at a time.

operations.name: deals.create
operations.purpose: Creates a deal in a pipeline stage, optionally associated with contacts and companies.

operations.name: deals.get
operations.purpose: Reads one deal by its id.

operations.name: deals.update
operations.purpose: Changes some of a deal's properties, its stage (dealstage) among them.

operations.name: deals.search
operations.purpose: Finds deals by their properties, a page at a time.

operations.name: dealPipelines.list
operations.purpose: Lists the account's deal pipelines with their stages: the internal ids a deal's pipeline and dealstage take.

operations.name: notes.create
operations.purpose: Creates a note (hs_note_body, hs_timestamp) on the timeline of the contacts, companies and deals it's associated with.

operations.name: associations.create
operations.purpose: Associates two records with HubSpot's default (unlabeled) association type.

operations.name: associations.list
operations.purpose: Lists the records of one type a record is associated with, with each association's types, a page at a time.

operations.name: associations.delete
operations.purpose: Removes every association between two records. The records stay.

signature.description: The header is the base64 HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the app's client secret, of the UTF-8 string: the request method, the full request URI as HubSpot called it (https://host/path?query, with %3A %2F %3F %40 %21 %24 %27 %28 %29 %2A %2C %3B in the query decoded), the raw body, and the X-HubSpot-Request-Timestamp header (Unix milliseconds), concatenated. Reject a timestamp more than five minutes old.

events.meaning: One of a contact's subscribed properties changed: propertyName and propertyValue say which, and to what.
Contacts were merged: primaryObjectId remains, mergedObjectIds were merged into it.
A contact was associated with, or dissociated from, another record.
A contact was deleted for privacy compliance: delete what the app holds about them.
One of a company's subscribed properties changed.
A company was associated with, or dissociated from, another record.
One of a deal's subscribed properties changed: dealstage, when it moved stage.
A deal was associated with, or dissociated from, another record.
A record was created (generic subscriptions: objectTypeId says which kind, 0-1 for a contact).
One of a record's subscribed properties changed (generic subscriptions).
A deleted record was restored (generic subscriptions).
